args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
Changed `round_money` in `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the docstring, the test expectations, and FIN-212:
- `2.665` now rounds to `2.66` (banker's rounding) instead of `2.67`.

## Verification
CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed (tests/test_money.py green).
